# Video to Prompt

> > Free AI-powered tool that converts videos, images, and TikToks into detailed prompts for Runway, Midjourney, Pika, and other AI generation platforms using Google Gemini API.

Video to Prompt specializes in reverse-engineering visual content into optimized text prompts for AI video and image generation. The platform supports scene-by-scene analysis, TikTok URL conversion, and image-to-prompt generation, helping creators replicate viral content and streamline their AI workflow.

## Core Tools & Features

- [Video to Prompt | Free AI Video Prompt Generator Tool](https://video-to-prompt.com): Homepage: Free AI tool converts videos to prompts using Gemini AI
- [Video to Prompt Scene by Scene | Extract Prompt from video](https://video-to-prompt.com/scenes): Scene-by-scene video analysis tool for multi-scene prompt extraction
- [TikTok Video to Prompt | Free AI TikTok Prompt Generator](https://video-to-prompt.com/tiktok): TikTok URL-to-prompt converter using Gemini AI for Runway/Pika
- [Image to Prompt | Free AI Image Prompt Generator Tool](https://video-to-prompt.com/image): Image-to-prompt generator for DALL-E, Midjourney using Gemini AI
